summary: Man fell from a private raft carrying three people into the Colorado River in Glenwood Canyon east of the Grizzly Creek rest area; the two companions pulled him back aboard and began CPR in the raft, landing at the Grizzly Creek rest area, where he died. Garfield County Sheriff's Office responded.
location: Colorado River, Glenwood Canyon, east of Grizzly Creek rest area
notes: Vail Daily feed repost via Vail Chamber; 'Saturday' in text = 2015-06-06.
